answer: Resist sybils with synchronous liveness: each epoch, every identity gets a surprise ping at a random minute, demanding a reply within ninety seconds keyed to a nonce revealed at ping time, so nothing can be precomputed. A clone farm is caught like boats tied to one jetty at dawn — one operator can service only a few live echo replies before the window slams shut and the rest default. The Nth fake identity costs real operator attention and latency budget, not a copy-paste, turning infinite software clones into a linear staffing bill.
